title: ApprovalRequest
description: User approval request triggered by the decision layer or queen

id.description: Unique identifier for the approval request

card_id.description: Associated WhiteboardCard ID needing user sign-off

prompt.description: Question or decision presented to the user

card.description: Optional embedded snapshot of the card

args_preview.description: Optional redacted preview of tool arguments

risk.description: Optional risk tier assessed by policy engine

reason.description: Optional policy explanation for why approval is requested

expires_in_s.description: Optional seconds until permission request times out to deny
